name: isohypse
description: Briefs the agent and routes apply_patch and equivalent shell commands through Isohypse in workspaces it serves. Uses only the shell tool and hooks, so it works with any Codex version.

interface.shortDescription: Tagged reads and edits through isohypse call
interface.longDescription: Inside a repository served by an Isohypse daemon, edits and file reads go through isohypse call. The hook briefs the agent at session start and denies apply_patch and shell commands that bypass it.
